findings.summary: The 1.4s hero entrance, which moves 80px and scales the heading and paragraph, has no prefers-reduced-motion branch, and the headline stays hidden until it finishes.
findings.fix: Add a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule that removes the translate/scale (keep at most a short opacity fade), and shorten the default duration.

findings.summary: The background video autoplays and loops forever, with no pause control and no reduced-motion check.
findings.fix: Skip autoplay (show the poster frame) when matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') matches, and add a visible pause control.

findings.summary: The parallax scroll handler writes a transform on every scroll event, with no requestAnimationFrame batching and no passive listener.
findings.fix: Register the listener with { passive: true } and batch the transform write in requestAnimationFrame, or use a CSS scroll-driven animation.

findings.summary: The parallax layer moves at 0.6x scroll speed even when the user has asked for reduced motion.
findings.fix: Don't attach the parallax handler, or leave the layer static, when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matches.

findings.summary: The card hover lift animates top and width, which are layout properties, and will-change lists top and width, so every hovered card triggers layout.
findings.fix: Lift the card with transform: translateY(-8px), transition only transform and box-shadow, and drop top and width from will-change.

findings.summary: Each 'Learn more' link stays at opacity 0 until hover, so touch users cannot see it.
findings.fix: Show the link by default and limit the hover reveal to @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).

findings.summary: The invisible 'Learn more' links can still receive Tab focus, but focus never makes them visible.
findings.fix: Add .card:focus-within .more { opacity: 1 } alongside the hover rule.

findings.summary: On every scroll event the handler reads getBoundingClientRect and then writes style.width for each of 24 cards in turn, which forces repeated layouts.
findings.fix: Remove the width change, or detect visibility with an IntersectionObserver and toggle a class instead of reading layout on every scroll.

findings.summary: The progress bar changes width on every unthrottled scroll event, so each update triggers layout.
findings.fix: Animate transform: scaleX() from a left transform-origin inside a requestAnimationFrame callback, or use a scroll-timeline.

findings.summary: button:focus { outline: none } removes the focus indicator from every button, including Sign up and Close.
findings.fix: Delete the rule, or replace it with a clearly visible :focus-visible outline.

findings.summary: Opening the modal does not move focus into it, Tab can leave it, Escape does not close it, and closing does not return focus to the trigger.
findings.fix: Use a native <dialog> with showModal(), or move focus to the first field, trap Tab, close on Escape, and restore focus to #open on close.

findings.summary: Reopening the modal within 350ms of closing it lets the pending close timeout remove .open, so the dialog vanishes right after it opens; the open and close timers are never cancelled.
findings.fix: Keep the timeout IDs and clear the pending one before each open or close, or remove .open on transitionend only if the modal is still closing.

findings.summary: The counter spins continuously even when the user prefers reduced motion.
findings.fix: When prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matches, render the final value without animating it.

findings.summary: The counter's requestAnimationFrame loop has no end condition, so it updates the DOM every frame forever and the number grows without limit.
findings.fix: Animate toward a fixed target over a set duration and stop scheduling frames once it is reached.

findings.summary: The requestAnimationFrame loop is never cancelled when the panel unmounts, so switching tabs leaves orphaned loops running on detached nodes and each remount stacks another one.
findings.fix: Store the frame ID and call cancelAnimationFrame from an unmount/cleanup function that runs before the panel's innerHTML is replaced.

findings.summary: Each mount creates a new IntersectionObserver that is never disconnected, so observers keep holding removed elements.
findings.fix: Call io.disconnect() in the unmount cleanup, or unobserve each element once it has received the 'in' class.

findings.summary: Every mountStats call adds another window resize listener, and none are removed, so they pile up and keep referencing detached counter elements.
findings.fix: Keep a handler reference and remove it with removeEventListener on unmount, or use an AbortController signal, or move the sizing into a CSS media query.

findings.summary: touch-action: none on html and body disables native touch scrolling and pinch-zoom for the whole page.
findings.fix: Remove touch-action from html/body and, if needed, set touch-action: pan-y on the carousel track only.

findings.summary: The slide transition runs at full motion with no reduced-motion fallback.
findings.fix: Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .track { transition: none; } }.

findings.summary: The navigation controls appear only on :hover, so touch users never see the dots.
findings.fix: Show the controls by default, or limit the hover reveal to @media (hover: hover) and also reveal on :focus-within.

findings.summary: The dots are non-focusable divs with only click handlers, so keyboard users cannot change slides.
findings.fix: Use <button> elements with aria-labels (for example 'Show testimonial 2') and a visible focus style.

findings.summary: Slides auto-advance every 3 seconds with no pause control and no reduced-motion check, so the text moves while people are reading it.
findings.fix: Turn off auto-rotation when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matches, and add a visible pause/play button.

findings.summary: The autoplay timer keeps running through dot clicks, swipes, hover and focus, so the next slide can arrive moments after the user navigates by hand.
findings.fix: Keep the interval ID, pause it on hover, focus-within and touch, and restart it after each manual go() call.
